mapper.select: SELECT a.adj_id, a.tank_id, tk.tank_name, tk.fuel_type, a.book_stock, a.physical_stock, a.diff_volume, a.diff_amount, a.adj_date, a.memo, a.input_type, a.created_at FROM tb_stock_adjustment a JOIN tb_tank tk ON a.tank_id = tk.tank_id WHERE a.adj_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY a.adj_date ASC, a.adj_id ASC

SELECT a.adj_id, a.tank_id, tk.tank_name, tk.fuel_type, a.book_stock, a.physical_stock, a.diff_volume, a.diff_amount, a.adj_date, a.memo, a.input_type, a.created_at FROM tb_stock_adjustment a JOIN tb_tank tk ON a.tank_id = tk.tank_id WHERE a.tank_id = #{tankId} ORDER BY a.adj_date ASC, a.adj_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_stock_adjustment (tank_id, book_stock, physical_stock, diff_volume, diff_amount, adj_date, memo, input_type, created_at) VALUES (#{tankId}, #{bookStock}, #{physicalStock}, #{diffVolume}, #{diffAmount}, #{adjDate}, #{memo}, #{inputType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, NOW())
